title: Annual Safety Review series

verified_observations.archive: EASA exposes an Annual Safety Review archive with editions covering the BSFM evaluation interval.
verified_observations.fatal_accident_appendices: Recent editions expose Appendix 1, List of Fatal Accidents.
verified_observations.asr_2025_global_context: ASR 2025 reports 14 fatal airline accidents worldwide in 2024 with 304 fatalities, alongside European commercial-air-transport analysis.
verified_observations.asr_2024_appendix_1: The directly inspected ASR 2024 Appendix 1 lists fatal accidents by EASA safety domains and contains historical rows through 2023; its commercial-air-transport complex-aeroplane section is not a demonstrated exhaustive worldwide commercial-jet census.

limitations: EASA annual reviews are not assumed to be a Boeing-only census.
Edition structure, domain scope and appendix availability differ and must be verified year by year.
ASR 2024 Appendix 1 cannot support a global zero-Boeing attestation for 2023 merely because no Boeing row appears in the inspected commercial-air-transport complex-aeroplane section.
Each candidate event still requires BSFM Boeing/commercial/fatal target adjudication and duplicate reconciliation.
Global-context counts alone cannot attest a BSFM census year.
